snippet.title: TGS 2011 - リズム怪盗R / Rhythm Phantom Thief R (?) - Sega Special Stage Dance!
snippet.description:
This is part of the Sega Special Stage for the promotion of the upcoming game リズム怪盗R (the English title would be Rhythm Phantom Thief R, maybe?) at TGS 2011. 

I just recorded the dancing part, but I missed the beginning because I wouldn't expect people to start dancing in this game promotion event XD

I'm really into this game =D
